**Pull requests are not being accepted before v1.0.0.** A PR opened now will
likely be closed, because the internals it touches may not survive the next
release. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/dberzins/wollix/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Bug reports, API feedback and platform reports are very welcome as
[issues](https://github.com/dberzins/wollix/issues/new/choose).
